searches.reason: Develop paired history interventions—recent-prefix removal, repeated-interest removal, and order shuffling—to test whether recommendations depend on supported current interests. Compare changes in direct-match rankings against length-matched random removals; use training-only chronological holdouts and uncertainty estimates to connect failures to sequence modeling and recency weighting without claiming causal user preferences.

searches.reason: Build evidence-grounded probes for the reported gap between broadly related recommendations and specific usable matches. Investigate extracting artist, format, device compatibility, and specifications from available titles/descriptions, measuring redundant recommendations, and distinguishing explicit conflicts from unknown information. Validate extraction and feedback coding on a small audited sample; do not infer ownership satisfaction or unobserved simulator traits.

searches.reason: Replace single-negative margins and raw embedding cosine with diagnostics whose usefulness is validated against ranking failures.
